document.title: Shell input coverage and a stronger re-activation assertion
document.summary: The VitaDeck Shell's input handling moves behind an input snapshot (`shell_apply_system_input`) so a new CTest harness drives restart, removal confirm/cancel and upload cancel headless; the Shell also clears its message on hide, frees the upload server mutex on shutdown, and `package_library_harness` checks re-activation more strictly.
document.why: [The Shell reads raylib input directly, so Shell behaviour has no CTest coverage](source:s1), and the re-activation case in `package_library_harness` only asserted something that was already true before the call.

sources.title: Shell has no automated input coverage; strengthen the re-activation harness assertion
sources.gist: Extract Shell input into a snapshot-driven function and cover restart, removal confirm/cancel and upload cancel; tighten the re-activation assertion; optionally clear the Shell message on hide.

groups.title: Shell input snapshot
groups.why: A harness can only drive the Shell headless once its logic stops calling raylib; [the issue asks for a snapshot like `src/ui/input.c`](source:s1).
groups.summary: `shell_poll_system_input` samples the same seven raylib bindings into a `VdShellInput` and hands it to the new `shell_apply_system_input`, which holds the unchanged Shell logic with `input->x` in place of the old `x_pressed()` helpers.

groups.title: Shell message cleared on hide
groups.why: [Item 3 of the issue](source:s1): "Restarted X." reappeared on the next Shell open.
groups.summary: `hide_shell_to_deck` clears `shell->message`, so `activate_package` no longer writes the success message it would immediately wipe.
lookFor: Behavior: "Activated X." and "Restarted X." are gone entirely; a failed `package_library_set_active` still writes its error and keeps the Shell open, and an upload result that arrives while the Shell is hidden still shows on the next open, because only hiding clears the message.

groups.title: Upload server mutex freed on shutdown
groups.why: The new harness runs under LeakSanitizer in the CI smoke job, which flagged the mutex `upload_server_init` allocates and nothing freed.
groups.summary: `shell_shutdown` destroys the upload server mutex after `upload_server_stop` has joined the listener and handler threads.
lookFor: Production change from a test PR: `main.c` calls `shell_shutdown` once at exit, so the app now frees the mutex there too; a second call is harmless because `upload_server_stop` early-returns and `vd_mutex_destroy(NULL)` does nothing.

groups.title: shell_input_harness
groups.why: Covers what [the issue lists](source:s1): restart, removal confirm/cancel and upload cancel.
groups.summary: The harness publishes two packages into a temp `VITADECK_DATA_ROOT`, stubs `input_ignore_held_pad_buttons`, and walks the Shell through open/hide, restart, activation, removal and the Upload listener with single-button `VdShellInput` frames; CMake builds and registers it with the real package library and upload server.
lookFor: The upload test binds a real listener on 8787-8796, so a running host listener only pushes it to the next port.

groups.title: Re-activation assertion
groups.why: [Item 2 of the issue](source:s1): the old assertion only checked `items[1].is_active`.
groups.summary: After re-activating `b.vdapp`, the harness also checks `!items[0].is_active` and that `package_library_active_package_name` still returns `b.vdapp`.
